mistake_reason: The orchestrator prematurely terminated the investigation after confirming only X (Twitter) follower count and declared X as the largest audience without completing the planned verification of LinkedIn’s follower count. Despite partial indicators of authenticity and common knowledge that Andrew Ng’s LinkedIn following is higher, the orchestrator ended the task before all necessary information was gathered, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
